quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: Which vehicle was the mistake, and where did the speaker end up?
quests.explanation: The speaker took the wrong train and arrived at the beach. The other pictures change the vehicle or the place.
quests.textToSpeak: Sorry I'm late; I got on the wrong train and ended up at the beach.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: The speaker avoids a strong opinion. What is the overall feeling?
quests.explanation: 'Not bad' but not as expected means mild disappointment. The neutral face fits.
quests.textToSpeak: I'm not saying the food was bad; it just wasn't what I was expecting. I thought it would be a lot spicier.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: The doctor is late. What will the speaker do while waiting?
quests.explanation: The doctor is behind schedule, so the speaker waits and gets a coffee.
quests.textToSpeak: The receptionist said the doctor's running about twenty minutes behind, so I might as well grab a coffee.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Did he go to the game? Why or why not?
quests.explanation: 'Would have gone if he hadn't' means he did not go. He rested at home injured.
quests.textToSpeak: He'd have gone to the game if he hadn't twisted his ankle, but the doctor told him to stay off his feet for a week.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: What is being requested, and who is sleeping?
quests.explanation: The request is for lower volume because a little boy is asleep.
quests.textToSpeak: Would you mind turning the music down a bit? My little boy's just fallen asleep, and I don't want to wake him.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: A description of how to find a place. Note each detail.
quests.explanation: Tall building, red door, opposite the bakery. Each other picture changes one detail.
quests.textToSpeak: You can't miss it; it's the tall building with the red door, right opposite the bakery.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: The planned time and the new time are different.
quests.explanation: Half past nine was the plan, but the delay moves it to ten.
quests.textToSpeak: The train's supposed to arrive at half past nine, but the board says it's been delayed until ten.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: The speaker is avoiding something. Which item is left out?
quests.explanation: Cutting down on sugar means no sugar in the coffee. One biscuit is the treat.
quests.textToSpeak: I've been trying to cut down on sugar, so I'll just have a black coffee and maybe one biscuit.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: The speakers consider two routes. Which one do they choose, and why?
quests.explanation: Darkness is coming, so they'll take the main road, not the park.
quests.textToSpeak: We could take the shortcut through the park, but it'll be dark soon, so it's probably safer to go round by the main road.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Two times are mentioned. Which one is when the speaker arrived?
quests.explanation: The shop closes at five, but the speaker arrived at six and found it locked.
quests.textToSpeak: Nobody told me the shop closes at five on Saturdays, so I turned up at six and found it all locked up.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Recipe steps. Put the ingredients in the correct order.
quests.explanation: Onions are chopped and fried first, then the tomatoes are added.
quests.textToSpeak: Once you've chopped the onions, fry them until they're soft, then stir in the tomatoes and let it simmer.

quests.instruction: Listen carefully and tap the best matching picture.
quests.hint: What does the speaker plan to do, and what actually happens?
quests.explanation: The gym is only an intention. In reality the speaker sits at home in front of the TV.
quests.textToSpeak: I keep meaning to go to the gym, but by the time I get home from work, all I want to do is sit down and watch something.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: Several rules are given. Which one includes a time?
quests.explanation: The rule about the bus is 'by four', which is 4:00.
quests.textToSpeak: The guide told us to stay together, not to touch anything, and to be back at the bus by four.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: The speaker's opinion changed. What is it now?
quests.explanation: 'Used to hate' is the past. 'Can't get enough' means loves them now.
quests.textToSpeak: It's funny; I used to hate mushrooms, but now I can't get enough of them.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: He moved from one kind of place to another. What did he feel?
quests.explanation: He was from the coast and then saw snow in the north for the first time, with amazement.
quests.textToSpeak: Being from the coast, he'd never seen snow until he moved north, and he was amazed when it started to fall.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Two things went wrong. What does the picture need to show?
quests.explanation: He forgot the birthday and the cake, so the cake is missing and the person is upset.
quests.textToSpeak: Not only did he forget her birthday, he also forgot to pick up the cake he'd ordered.

quests.instruction: Build the scene in your mind, then tap the matching picture.
quests.hint: What was unavailable, and what did the speaker order?
quests.explanation: Fish had run out. The speaker asked for chicken instead.
quests.textToSpeak: The waiter apologized and said the kitchen had run out of fish, so I asked if I could have the chicken instead.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: The habit and the reaction. What are they?
quests.explanation: The shoes are still in the doorway, which is why the speaker is annoyed.
quests.textToSpeak: I've told him a hundred times not to leave his shoes in the doorway, but he still does.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: What woke up the speaker's memory, and what happened next?
quests.explanation: A midnight text came first, then all-night revision.
quests.textToSpeak: I'd totally forgotten about the exam until a friend texted me at midnight, so I stayed up all night revising.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Two stops are mentioned. Which one is requested?
quests.explanation: The stop after the hospital is the one requested. The one before is rejected.
quests.textToSpeak: Please tell the driver we'd like to get off at the stop after the hospital, not the one before.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Where did they eat, and what was missing?
quests.explanation: There was no table, so they sat on the grass outside.
quests.textToSpeak: It was so crowded that we couldn't find a table, so we ended up sitting on the grass outside with our plates on our knees.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: The plan has two parts: what comes first and what comes later.
quests.explanation: They arrive early to eat, and the film follows.
quests.textToSpeak: The film starts at eight, but if we get there half an hour early, we can grab some food first.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: The speaker lists problems and then a plan. What is the plan?
quests.explanation: 'Thinking of getting a new one' is the plan, and it means buying.
quests.textToSpeak: My phone's been acting up; it keeps freezing, and the battery lasts a couple of hours, so I'm thinking of getting a new one.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: What did people expect, and what actually happened?
quests.explanation: The expectation was wrong: the quiet boy was correct.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone assumed the quiet boy at the back wouldn't know the answer, but he was the only one who got it right.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: Notice the vehicle, the place and the round trip.
quests.explanation: 'To the sea and back' is a round trip. The vehicle is the bike she saved for.
quests.textToSpeak: She'd been saving for two years to buy a bike, and when she finally got it, she rode it all the way to the sea and back.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: What did they choose to do instead of complaining?
quests.explanation: They walked in the rain with sandwiches. 'Anyway' shows the rain didn't stop them.
quests.textToSpeak: Instead of complaining about the weather, they packed sandwiches and went for a walk in the rain anyway.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: How does he get to work, and what doesn't he have?
quests.explanation: He has no car, so he cycles to work every day.
quests.textToSpeak: He's the only one in the office who doesn't own a car; he cycles in every morning, whatever the weather.

quests.instruction: Listen to the whole message, then tap the picture that matches its meaning.
quests.hint: Three jobs were finished before the guests came. Read left to right.
quests.explanation: The order is cooking, table, dress. 'Even' marks the last, extra job.
quests.textToSpeak: By the time the guests arrived, she'd finished the cooking, set the table, and even had time to change her dress.

quests.instruction: Tap the picture that matches what the speaker means.
quests.hint: Did the sofa arrive? What happened instead?
quests.explanation: 'Put it off until next week' means postponed, so the delivery is delayed.
quests.textToSpeak: Apparently the shop that was meant to deliver our sofa this morning has put it off until next week because of a strike.

quests.instruction: Listen to the speaker and choose the picture that fits best.
quests.hint: The speaker's opinion changed. Where do they live, and how do they feel?
quests.explanation: They once said no to the city, but now they love it and don't want to return to the village.
quests.textToSpeak: I know I always said I'd never live in a big city, but after two years here I honestly can't imagine going back to the village.
